battle.name: 高加索戰爭
battle.theater: 裏海西南岸與亞塞拜然西北部
battle.brief: 一八一七年春，俄軍獨立高加索集團軍在帕斯凱維奇率領下越過山嶺反攻，連奪德爾賓特、卡拉巴赫與卡潘，並於阿斯蘭杜茲擊潰波斯騎兵主力；七月裏海分艦隊攻下蘭卡拉朗，波斯在裏海的水師就此覆亡。火繩槍到這時早已被燧發步槍取代，只殘存於軍械庫與部分地方民兵手中。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 交戰的兩方是俄羅斯帝國與卡札爾伊朗。俄方以獨立高加索集團軍為主幹，由帕斯凱維奇中將統一指揮，轄有步兵團、炮兵、工兵與騎兵，骨幹是庫班與捷列克兩支哥薩克騎兵團；沿高加索防線修築的堡壘鏈——基茲利亞爾、格羅茲尼、符拉季卡夫卡茲一線——既是後勤樞紐，也是發兵地，另有葉爾莫洛夫率領的達吉斯坦裏海分艦隊，能自行沿裏海北岸運兵運糧。俄方陣線外還有格魯吉亞民兵，以及帝國在當地逐步建立起來的民政機構，遠征時與軍隊同步接管地方事務。波斯一方由德黑蘭的卡札爾朝廷直接主持，國王法塔希·阿里沙居最高統帥之位，亞塞拜然總督阿薩夫·道拉實際指揮前線兵團，另有設於大不里士的沙哈直屬中央部隊，以及吉蘭、馬贊達蘭、庫巴一線的省軍與部落徵召兵；波斯的裏海分艦隊以蘭卡拉朗為基地，是它僅有的海上力量。值得注意的是高加索山區的埃麥列特，一個獨立於兩方的伊斯蘭政權，雖未派兵參戰，卻是俄軍推進的真正背景，也是波斯尋求外援的方向，英國駐德黑蘭公使歐斯利在戰爭期間的報告反覆提到它。
countriesEn: The two sides in the conflict were the Russian Empire and the Qajar state of Iran. On the Russian side the backbone was the Separate Caucasus Corps, under the unified command of Lieutenant-General Ivan Paskevich, comprising infantry regiments, artillery, engineers and cavalry, with the Kuban and Terek Cossack hosts forming the cavalry core; the chain of forts along the Caucasian Line, at Kizlyar, Grozny and Vladikavkaz, served both as supply hubs and as assembly points for the offensive, and there was in addition the Daghestan Caspian flotilla under Yermolov, which could move troops and stores along the north Caspian shore on its own. Beyond the Russian line there were the Georgian militias and the civil administration the Empire was gradually building up in the region, which took over local affairs as the army advanced. The Persian side was directed from the Qajar court at Tehran, with Shah Fath-Ali Shah as supreme commander and the governor-general of Azerbaijan, Asaf al-Dawla, actually commanding the field corps; there were also the central troops of the Shah stationed at Tabriz, and the provincial levies and tribal contingents of Gilan, Mazandaran and Quba. The Persian Caspian squadron, based at Lankaran, was the only maritime force the state possessed. Noteworthy is the Imamate of the Caucasus, an Islamic polity independent of both sides; although it sent no troops into this war, it was the true background of the Russian advance and the direction in which Persia looked for outside support, and the reports of the British ambassador at Tehran, Sir Gore Ouseley, referred to it repeatedly during the fighting.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的是俄方的帕斯凱維奇。他以三十五歲之齡接掌獨立高加索集團軍，在德黑蘭政局混亂、歐洲列強又盯住同一片棋盤的雙重壓力之下，選擇主動出兵而不是坐等談判：一八一七年春他率主力越過山嶺向波斯縱深推進，七月十九日於阿斯蘭杜茲以炮兵前推與密集縱隊擊潰波斯騎兵主力。集團軍參謀長尼古拉·拉耶夫斯基負責全軍行政與作戰計劃，砲兵軍官加夫里洛夫在阿斯蘭杜茲率車載砲掩護縱隊轉向，穩住陣腳。另一條戰線由葉爾莫洛夫主持，他率達吉斯坦分艦隊於五月二十六日夜襲德爾賓特，之後又以十餘艘划槳砲艇封鎖蘭卡拉朗，逼降波斯分艦隊；德爾波佐將軍則在1816年擊退波斯入侵達吉斯坦的企圖，替一八一七年的反攻爭取了喘息。波斯方面的關鍵人物是國王法塔希·阿里沙與阿薩夫·道拉（阿拉亞爾汗）：前者要的是收回割讓的裏海西岸土地，後者以總督身分在前線失利後仍力主再戰，十九日在阿斯蘭杜茲率大批騎兵衝鋒，隨即兵敗受傷，隨軍門帳、火砲與輜重盡為俄軍所取。英國公使歐斯利全程在德黑蘭觀察並不斷寫信回報，勸波斯抵抗俄國在裏海方向的擴張，這一立場同時是倫敦在印度方向佈局的一環。
peopleEn: The man who decided the course of the war was Paskevich on the Russian side. At thirty-five he took command of the Separate Caucasus Corps, and under the double pressure of a confused court at Tehran and of the European powers watching the same board, he chose to strike first rather than wait for negotiations: in the spring of 1817 he led the main body across the mountains into the depth of Persian territory, and on 19 July at Aslanduz he broke the Persian cavalry with his artillery pushed forward and his columns close-packed. The corps chief of staff, General Nikolay Raevsky, handled the administration and the operational planning of the whole army, while the artillery officer Gavrilov covered the turning of the columns with his horse guns at Aslanduz and held the line steady. A second front was run by Yermolov, who led the Daghestan flotilla in the night assault on Derbent on 26 May and later blockaded Lankaran with a dozen or more rowing gunboats, compelling the Persian squadron to surrender; General Delpozzo had already repelled the Persian attempt to invade Dagestan in 1816, which bought the breathing space for the counter-offensive of 1817. The decisive figures on the Persian side were Shah Fath-Ali Shah and Asaf al-Dawla, also known as Allah-Yar Khan: the first wanted the lost lands on the west Caspian shore back, the second, as governor-general, pressed on after the defeat on the front and lost the battle of Aslanduz on the nineteenth with the bulk of the Persian cavalry, being wounded, while the tents, guns and baggage of the army fell to the Russians. The British ambassador Ouseley watched the whole business from Tehran and reported it continuously, urging Persia to resist Russian expansion towards the Caspian, a position that was itself part of the London calculation about India.
kits: 火繩槍在這場戰爭裡已經是退役的舊物。西班牙自十七世紀起以燧發槍逐步取代火繩槍，到一八一七年，連歐洲的火繩戰術都早已讓位給燧發滑膛步槍與定裝紙包的制度，火繩槍只剩下兩個位置：一是帝國與波斯各處軍械庫、兵工廠與博物館的館藏，二是少數省軍與部落徵召兵手上尚未淘汰的舊槍。真正決定一八一七年戰局的是俄軍的燧發步槍：步兵團裝備一七九六年式與一八〇三年式滑膛燧發步槍，另有少量一八一一年式線膛燧發步槍配刺刀；騎兵用卡賓槍與馬刀，哥薩克用長矛（納加伊卡）、彎刀與自備短槍。炮兵以輕野戰砲、六磅砲與榴彈砲為主，砲隊用車載砲配備，靠馬匹牽引在山間道路行軍，沒有可用的攻城重砲。波斯步兵用滑膛燧發長槍（圖凡），部分地方民兵仍用長身與短身火繩槍，也就是伊朗記載中的土方系列；騎兵裝備卡札爾彎刀、標槍與火槍，炮兵數量有限，多為中小口徑舊砲。攻城方面沒有配重撞錘與攻城塔，攻德爾賓特靠夜襲、攀城與工兵掘壕，切蘭卡拉朗靠砲艇與火船封海；後勤上，俄軍靠裏海船運把糧秣從阿贊利港運到庫巴與德爾賓特，波斯靠大不里士、萊什特之間的驛馬隊與駱駝隊翻越山道，山路與冬春泥濘是雙方補給的共同瓶頸。
kitsEn: The matchlock musket was already a retired object in this war. Spain had replaced it with the flintlock step by step from the seventeenth century, and by 1817 even the European matchlock drill had long given way to flintlock smoothbore muskets and the system of paper cartridges; the matchlock occupied only two places: the collections of arsenals, foundries and museums in both states, and the hands of a few provincial levies and tribal contingents that had not yet got rid of the old guns. What actually decided the fighting in 1817 was the Russian flintlock musket. The infantry regiments carried the 1796-pattern and 1803-pattern smoothbore flintlock muskets, with a small number of 1811-pattern rifled flintlock muskets fitted with bayonets; the cavalry used carbines and sabres, and the Cossacks the long lance, the nagaika, the sabre and their own short arms. The artillery consisted of light field guns, six-pounders and howitzers, organised as horse batteries travelling on wheels and drawn by horses along mountain tracks, and no heavy siege gun was available. Persian infantry used smoothbore flintlock long guns, the tufang, and some local levies still carried long and short matchlocks, the tufang family of the Persian records. The Persian cavalry carried Qajar sabres, lances and firearms, and their artillery was limited, mostly old guns of small calibre. There was no counterweight battering ram and no siege tower; Derbent was taken by night assault, scaling and sapping by engineers, and Lankaran by sealing the harbour with gunboats and fireships. On the logistics side the Russians moved grain and stores by Caspian shipping from Anzali up to Quba and Derbent, while Persia relied on post horses and camel caravans between Tabriz and Rasht and over the mountain tracks; the mountain roads and the mud of late winter and early spring were a common bottleneck for both supply systems.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術骨架是縱隊加要塞，而不是會戰。俄軍沿德爾賓特至庫巴一線唯一可行的山道推進，步兵縱隊之間由工兵連接，炮兵緊隨先頭，哥薩克騎兵在兩翼警戒；道路狹窄且多山嶺，縱隊必須拉得很長，行軍與戰鬥幾乎是同一件事。縱隊一旦拉開，縱深與彈藥供應就是最大的弱點，裏海分艦隊因此成為真正的戰略支隊，隨著陸隊推進把糧秣與砲兵向前轉送，解決了山區遠征最難解決的一段。攻擊德爾賓特時，葉爾莫洛夫率突擊縱隊在夜裡自低窪處逼近城牆，先以工兵破障，再以步兵攀城，五月二十六日奪下要塞；蘭卡拉朗的陷落則由海上完成，十餘艘砲艇在掩護下迫近，擊毀或逼降波斯分艦隊，波斯在裏海的海上存在就此結束。波斯方面的戰術建立在騎兵優勢上，阿拉亞爾汗率大批騎兵屢次襲擾俄軍側翼與補給線，試圖以機動消耗遠征軍，最後在阿斯蘭杜茲以密集騎兵衝鋒，試圖在正面摧毀俄軍縱隊；俄軍則以砲兵前推與結陣應對，在騎兵接近前完成數輪齊射，衝鋒被打散之後，波斯步兵與隨軍民兵隨之崩潰，後方營帳與輜重被大批俄軍騎兵奪取。整場戰爭裡俄軍還有一項制度性優勢：沿高加索防線的連續碉堡讓傷兵與補給可以沿線後送，使遠征不必一次押上全部兵力。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this war was column and fortress rather than set-piece battle. The Russians advanced along the only practicable mountain track from Derbent to Quba, the infantry columns linked by engineers, the artillery close behind the leading brigade, and the Cossack cavalry screening the flanks. Because the roads were narrow and the relief broken, the columns had to be drawn out until marching and fighting were almost the same thing, and once a column was stretched out its depth and its ammunition were its weakest points. The Caspian flotilla was therefore a true strategic arm, moving stores and guns forward with the infantry and solving the hardest part of a mountain expedition. At the assault on Derbent, Yermolov led the storming columns in by night across the low ground, the engineers first breaching the obstacles and the infantry then scaling the walls; the fall of the town on 26 May was the work of that night. Lankaran was won at sea instead: a dozen or more gunboats came up under cover, destroying or compelling the surrender of the Persian squadron, and with it the whole Persian maritime presence on the Caspian came to an end. Persian tactics rested on cavalry superiority. Allah-Yar Khan led large bodies of horsemen in repeated harrying of the Russian flanks and supply lines, trying to wear the expedition down by movement, and at Aslanduz he finally charged with massed cavalry in an attempt to break the Russian columns in the open. The Russians answered by pushing their guns forward and closing ranks, completing several rounds of volley before the horsemen were in contact. Once the charge was broken the Persian infantry and its accompanying levies collapsed with it, and the tents and baggage in the rear were taken by large numbers of Russian horsemen. The Russians also held a structural advantage throughout: the continuous chain of forts along the Caucasian Line allowed the wounded and the stores to move back along it, so that the expedition never had to stake everything on a single advance.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。俄軍一八一七年遠征的兵力，通用估計是一萬二千至一萬三千人，包含步兵、炮兵、工兵、哥薩克騎兵與後勤人員；若連同沿線守軍與分艦隊水兵，高加索戰區的俄軍總數可達兩萬上下。波斯方面，阿薩夫·道拉一八一六年進入達吉斯坦時所部兵眾，波斯方面的記載從一萬多到三萬不等；一八一七年對抗俄軍的軍隊則在一萬至兩萬之間，其中騎兵比例遠高於俄軍，攻城器械與攻城技術的配備則明顯不足。關鍵戰役的日期可考：德爾賓特於一八一七年五月二十六日被奪，卡拉巴赫戰役在六月二十六日，卡潘戰役在七月十五日，阿斯蘭杜茲會戰在七月十九日，蘭卡拉朗在七月二十八日淪陷。損失方面，阿斯蘭杜茲一役波斯軍被俘與散失者以千計，俄軍方面陣亡數百人；卡潘一役俄軍奪得波斯營帳、火砲與大批軍械物資；德爾賓特與蘭卡拉朗兩次突擊中，俄軍各損失十餘艘小型舟艇。距離與時間上，德爾賓特至庫巴約一百二十公里，庫巴至蘭卡拉朗約二百公里，整條追擊軸線長三百公里上下，遠征自春末到盛夏歷時約兩個月。財政方面，一八一三年《古爾斯坦條約》規定波斯向俄國支付約五百萬盧布的賠償並分期繳付，而一八一七年開戰的直接原因之一，正是這筆款項與條約執行的拖延。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Russian field force in the campaign of 1817 is generally estimated at twelve to thirteen thousand men, including infantry, artillery, engineers, Cossack cavalry and the rear services; adding the garrisons along the line and the flotilla crews, the total Russian strength in the Caucasus theatre approached twenty thousand. On the Persian side the size of Asaf al-Dawla's army when it entered Dagestan in 1816 is given in Persian accounts at anything from over ten thousand to thirty thousand; the force that faced the Russians in 1817 numbered between ten and twenty thousand, with a proportion of cavalry far higher than the Russian one and a clear shortage of siege equipment and siegecraft. The dates of the decisive actions can be checked: Derbent was taken on 26 May 1817, the battle of Karabakh was fought on 26 June, the battle of Kapan on 15 July, the battle of Aslanduz on 19 July, and Lankaran fell on 28 July. On losses, the Persian army at Aslanduz lost prisoners and stragglers numbering in the thousands against several hundred Russian dead; at Kapan the Russians took the Persian tents, guns and a great quantity of matériel; in the two surprise attacks on Derbent and Lankaran the Russians lost a dozen or so small craft apiece. On distance and time, Derbent to Quba is about one hundred and twenty kilometres and Quba to Lankaran about two hundred, making the whole axis of pursuit some three hundred kilometres, and the expedition lasted roughly two months from late spring to high summer. On finance, the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813 had set a compensation of about five million rubles payable by Persia to Russia in instalments, and one of the immediate reasons for the war of 1817 was precisely that money and the delay in carrying out the treaty.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是一八一三年《古爾斯坦條約》的執行爭議：條約把達吉斯坦、格魯吉亞與亞塞拜然的大部割給俄國，波斯分期應付的賠款拖著未付，條約中俄國在裏海保持艦隊的權利、俄國商人居留與通商條款也一直沒有落地。國王法塔希·阿里沙要的是收回裏海西岸與西北部被割之地，至少要讓古爾斯坦條約成為一紙空文。一八一六年，波斯在阿薩夫·道拉率領下兵入達吉斯坦、攻陷德爾賓特，並驅逐俄國居民與俄國商站，是對條約的直接撕毀，也是這場戰爭真正的導火線。深一層是國力的時機判斷：一八一二年拿破崙入侵俄國使俄軍主力西調，遠在數千里外的帝國參謀部對高加索鞭長莫及，波斯遂相信在歐洲大戰期間攻取邊境要塞的代價最低；英國公使歐斯利則勸德黑蘭抵抗俄國在裏海方向的擴張，德黑蘭據此相信倫敦至少不會攔阻。最深一層是俄國的戰略目標：把高加索防線從庫班河推到裏海，消滅山區的埃麥列特，將巴庫的石油與裏海航路收入版圖，並為將來向伊朗與印度方向擴張建立基地。歐洲局勢在一八一九年前後的變化讓聖彼得堡無力兼顧，高加索反而成了可以放手施為的方向，遠征因此不只是懲罰性行動，更是體系性擴張的開始。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The outermost was the dispute over the execution of the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813: the treaty had ceded Dagestan, Georgia and most of Azerbaijan to Russia, the compensation Persia was to pay in instalments remained unpaid, and the clauses giving Russia a fleet on the Caspian and the residence and trading rights of Russian subjects had never been implemented. Shah Fath-Ali Shah wanted the lost lands on the west Caspian shore and in the north-west back, and at the very least wanted the treaty of Gulistan to become a dead letter. In 1816 Persia under Asaf al-Dawla marched into Dagestan, seized Derbent and expelled the Russian inhabitants and the Russian trading posts. That was a direct tearing-up of the treaty, and it was the real occasion of the war. A deeper layer was the calculation about timing: Napoleon's invasion of Russia in 1812 drew the bulk of the Russian army west, and the imperial general staff thousands of kilometres away could not keep a tight hand on the Caucasus, so Persia judged that taking frontier fortresses would cost least while Europe fought its great war; the British ambassador Ouseley urged Tehran to resist Russian expansion towards the Caspian, and Tehran accordingly believed London would at least not stand in the way. The deepest layer was the Russian strategic aim: to push the Caucasian Line from the Kuban to the Caspian, to destroy the Imamate in the mountains, to bring the oil of Baku and the Caspian shipping lane under control, and to establish a base for future expansion towards Iran and India. As the European situation changed around 1819, St Petersburg could not attend to everything, and the Caucasus became the direction in which it could act without restraint; the expedition was therefore not only a punitive operation but the beginning of a systematic expansion.
impact: 影響分成近期的軍事與長期的地緣兩層。近期看，這場戰爭讓俄軍第一次在裏海方向以海陸協同作戰取得全勝：波斯分艦隊在蘭卡拉朗覆滅，波斯在裏海再無正規水師，克里米亞、伏爾加河流域與通往中亞的通道自此向俄國敞開。俄國也確認了一條經驗——以精兵配連續碉堡與裏海分艦隊，可以在沒有大後方的山區打一場有限而決定性的戰役；帕斯凱維奇據此在一八一八至一八一九年推進山區，一八一九年攻入阿瓦爾、鎮壓高加索埃麥列特的抵抗，把高加索防線的堡壘鏈條從捷列克河一路延伸到底格里斯，格魯吉亞的通道與黑海方向也納入堡壘網。對波斯而言，收復失地的企圖失敗，卻換來幾年喘息：一八一八年二月在古爾斯坦達成的協議重複了一八一三年條約的割地，讓波斯得以集中精力應付一八二六至一八二八年的俄波戰爭，也讓卡札爾朝廷把重心放在裏海沿岸的行政與財政整頓上。對英國而言，歐斯利在德黑蘭的報告把俄國在高加索與裏海方向的推進視為對英屬印度路徑的威脅，英俄之間在此後數十年於伊朗與中亞的角力，成為後人稱為大棋局的開端。長期看，這場戰爭是一八一七至一八六四年高加索戰爭的真正起點：高加索山民在火繩槍早已退場的年代，仍以火器與冷兵器抵抗了數十年，其後的民族記憶被寫進十九世紀末至二十世紀俄國的文學與政治論述之中。
impactEn: The effects divide into a short-term military layer and a long-term geopolitical one. In the short term the war gave the Russians their first complete victory by sea and land together in the Caspian direction: the Persian squadron was destroyed at Lankaran, Persia had no regular navy left on the Caspian, and the routes through the Crimea, the Volga basin and towards Central Asia stood open to Russia. The campaign also confirmed in Russian practice the lesson that a small force, supported by a chain of forts and by the Caspian flotilla, could fight a limited and decisive war in mountains without a great base behind it. Paskevich built on that in 1818 and 1819, driving into the mountains, taking Avaria in 1819 and crushing the resistance of the Caucasian Imamate, and extending the fort chain of the Caucasian Line from the Terek to the Tigris so that the Georgian passes and the direction of the Black Sea were drawn into the network. For Persia the attempt to recover lost territory failed, but it bought a few years of respite: the agreement concluded at Gulistan in February 1818 repeated the cessions of 1813, allowing Persia to concentrate on the Russo-Persian war of 1826 to 1828 and on the administrative and fiscal reorganisation of the Caspian littoral. For Britain, Ouseley's reports from Tehran read the Russian advance in the Caucasus and towards the Caspian as a threat to the road to British India, and the Anglo-Russian rivalry over Iran and Central Asia in the decades that followed was the opening of what is now called the Great Game. In the long run this war was the true beginning of the Caucasian War of 1817 to 1864: the mountaineers of the Caucasus kept up a resistance of firearms and cold steel for decades at a time when the matchlock had long left the field, and that resistance entered the literature and the political writing of late nineteenth and twentieth century Russia.
result: 結果是俄軍在戰場上完勝，在條約上卻沒有拿到新領土。帕斯凱維奇的遠征自德爾賓特一路推到基茲勒烏贊河與阿拉斯河一線，德爾賓特、庫巴、卡拉巴赫、卡潘與蘭卡拉朗相繼易手，德爾賓特要塞自一八一七年起即由俄國掌控，此後再未回到波斯手中。阿斯蘭杜茲一役，波斯騎兵衝鋒被擊潰，軍隊連同營帳、火砲與輜重盡失，國王法塔希·阿里沙在德黑蘭得到戰報後派員議和；蘭卡拉朗陷落則直接拆掉波斯在裏海的最後一塊盾牌，一八二六年的俄波戰爭再戰時，波斯已無可用之海軍。一八一八年二月在古爾斯坦簽訂的協議重複確認一八一三年條約的割地與賠款安排，並在俄國要求下增加通商與外交便利的條款，波斯接受後，遠征軍退回阿拉斯河以北，戰事停在一八一八年初。戰役層面上，德爾賓特與蘭卡拉朗兩次夜襲都沒有使用任何攻城重器械，靠工兵、突擊縱隊與砲艇完成，說明此時高加索的攻防仍以人力與地形為主。長期看，帕斯凱維奇在一八一九年成為高加索總督並恢復戰爭，一八二六至一八二八年的俄波戰爭中波斯再敗於土庫曼恰伊條約，裏海南岸的大片領土最終落到俄國手裏；而一八一七年這場戰爭真正留下的，是俄國在南高加索建立堡壘統治、把山區納入帝國版圖的完整經驗。
resultEn: The result was a complete Russian victory on the battlefield and no new territory at the treaty table. Paskevich's expedition pushed from Derbent as far as the Qizil Uzan and the Aras, and Derbent, Quba, Karabakh, Kapan and Lankaran changed hands in turn; Derbent passed under Russian control in 1817 and never returned to Persia. At Aslanduz the Persian cavalry charge was broken and the army lost its tents, guns and baggage with it, and when the reports reached Tehran Shah Fath-Ali Shah sent envoys to treat; the fall of Lankaran removed the last Persian shield on the Caspian, and when war came again in 1826 Persia had no navy to put into it. The agreement signed at Gulistan in February 1818 confirmed the cessions and the compensation arrangements of the treaty of 1813 and added trading and diplomatic facilities at Russian request; Persia accepted, the expedition withdrew north of the Aras, and the fighting stopped in early 1818. At the level of the operations, neither the night attack on Derbent nor the storm of Lankaran used any heavy siege equipment, both being carried by engineers, assault columns and gunboats, which shows that attack and defence in the Caucasus at this time still turned on manpower and terrain. In the long run, Paskevich became viceroy of the Caucasus in 1819 and the war was resumed; Persia was defeated again in the Russo-Persian war of 1826 to 1828 and lost further territory under the Treaty of Turkmenchay, and the southern Caspian lands eventually passed to Russia. What the war of 1817 truly left behind was the complete Russian experience of fort rule in the southern Caucasus and of bringing the mountains into the Empire.
